rules.title: San Francisco Annual Allowable Rent Increase 3/1/26 - 2/28/27
rules.citation: S.F. Rent Board Annual Allowable Increase 2026-2027
rules.quote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.summary: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the annual allowable rent increase is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.effective_until_evidence: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
